parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Identifies perpendicular gradient $m_{AB} = \dfrac{1}{3}$ and forms line equation through $A(7, 2)$ as $y - 2 = \dfrac{1}{3}(x - 7)$. — M1
Obtains line equation $x - 3y = 1$ (or $y = \dfrac{1}{3}x - \dfrac{1}{3}$). — A1
Solves intersection with $y = -3x + 8$ to obtain midpoint $M\left(\dfrac{5}{2}, \dfrac{1}{2}\right)$. — A1

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Uses midpoint relations $\dfrac{7 + x_B}{2} = \dfrac{5}{2}$ and $\dfrac{2 + y_B}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}$ to find $B(-2, -1)$. — M1
Calculates $AB = \sqrt{(7 - (-2))^2 + (2 - (-1))^2} = \sqrt{81 + 9} = 3\sqrt{10}$. — A1
